prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of two hands holding a black pencil horizontally against a softly blurred, neutral gray background. The focus is sharp on the pencil, which features white printed text reading “SCORE IN FRONT OF THE POST.” The hands are positioned at either end of the pencil, with the left thumb and forefinger gently gripping one side and the right hand holding the other, both hands rendered in warm, natural skin tones. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting subtle shadows and highlighting the texture of the skin and the matte finish of the pencil. The overall color palette is muted and understated, dominated by grays, blacks, and warm browns, creating a contemplative and intimate mood. The composition is minimalistic, with a shallow depth of field that isolates the subject and draws attention to the message on the pencil, evoking a sense of focus and quiet anticipation. The style is reminiscent of a dramatic film still, with careful attention to detail, lighting, and emotional resonance.
